name: fairy housekeeper

attributes.attribute: known as Toice bhair bear tiqhe
resides at the bottom of Lough Gur
flows dry once every seven years

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Fairy housekeeper, or Toice bhrean bear tiqhe, is an Irish folk figure. The enchanted Lough Gur in Limerick hides a strange being at its floor. Once in every seven years the lake waters vanish. The housekeeper then comes into view. She walks to a stone chair and rests there for a few hours. When the lake returns, she slips away from sight.

okr.objective: Fairy housekeeper is a figure who rises from Lough Gur each seven years.
key_results: A strange figure lives beneath the enchanted Lough Gur.
Once every seven years the lake runs dry.
The housekeeper walks to a stone chair and rests there.
She vanishes when the waters of the lake return.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
